mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in unemployment (PAYEMS) above 150 thousand signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when PAYEMS crosses the 150 threshold, or t-test p-value > 0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and rising GDP demand (GDPC1) creates a strong positive signal for equity valuations, driving 20-day forward returns upward.
failure_condition: The combined effect of FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 does not correlate with positive 20-day returns, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply growth, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not translate to positive 60-day returns in late-cycle environments, or t-test p-value > 0.05 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in quarterly GDP demand (GDPC1) below 10,000 billion chained 2017 dollars signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite GDPC1 falling below threshold, or p-value > 0.05 in such events.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) alongside falling unemployment rates (UNRATE) creates conflicting signals, resulting in negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not predict negative returns, or Rank IC > 0.03 over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with elevated unemployment (PAYEMS) suggests supply-demand imbalance, leading to negative 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The combination of high INDPRO and PAYEMS does not correlate with negative returns, or p-value > 0.05 in such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside tightening monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) generates uncertainty, causing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS does not result in negative returns, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
